description: Angular component for configuring propagation settings in the Thingsboard UI, including form controls, validation, and script testing.

classes.name: PropagationConfigurationComponent
classes.description: Angular component implementing ControlValueAccessor and Validator for propagation configuration in the UI.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the form configuration, returns validation errors or null.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Sets the form values from an external model.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers a callback for when the form value changes.

methods.name: registerOnTouched
methods.description: Registers a callback for when the form is touched.

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form controls.

methods.name: onTestScript
methods.description: Triggers the test script function and updates the expression field.

methods.name: fetchOptions
methods.description: Provides options for relation types based on search text.

methods.name: updatedModel
methods.description: Updates the external model with the current form state.

methods.name: updatedFormWithScript
methods.description: Enables or disables the expression input based on a checkbox.
